method: With all motors stopped in mode 0, user holds a starting right-rear leg pose A, manually moves its foot-side rotating member and holds pose B, then releases to stable pose C; read-only Type0 identity and Type17 run_mode/position, two position reads for each rear-bus ID 7..12 at each pose. No motor output sent.
operator_report: Operator visually estimated 5-10 degrees relative angle between the black QDD body and yellow foot-side rotating member. Operator confirmed the QDD metal output hub rotated with the yellow member. B was held, then released to stable C.
conclusion: ID7 Type17 position changed about 47 degrees during manual repositioning and remained at that position after release; both black-body/yellow-member visual motion and sensor response were observed, but visual displacement was only estimated at 5-10 degrees. Official RS05 manual calls 0x7019 load-side mechanical angle; do not divide by the 7.75:1 gearbox. The discrepancy remains unresolved. A continuous raw-angle trace during measured physical movement is needed to distinguish smooth change from a discrete jump. No motor output was sent; this does not validate active tracking or standing.

official_reference.source: RobStride RS05 User Manual 260713, 0x7019 mechPos is accumulated load-end mechanical angle (rad)

continuity_followup.result: INCOMPLETE before any position sample: ID7 identity timeout at 250 ms; subsequent read-only 1 s identity checks for IDs 7..12 and 1,4,6 also timed out. Both CH340 devices remain visible. Check QDD power path before retrying.
continuity_followup.power_restored: After the 40V switch was turned On again, read-only Type0 replies returned from ID7 and ID1 with matching UIDs.
continuity_followup.second_result: 15 s / 738 position samples, only 0.0312 degree range; operator reports visible metal-hub/yellow-member relative rotation during that interval. Timing/observation correspondence unresolved; interactive Enter-cued 20 s repeat prepared as ~/dog-id7-stream.
